'''Awaken and Corrupt''' is the fourth and final Act of the main [[Story]] campaign.

It is set right after [[Generations]].

== Transcript ==
[[Awaken and Corrupt/Transcript]]

== Rewards ==
[[File:ACT 4 CHAPTER 1 REWARDS.png|300px|centre|Chapter 1, so far]]

== Chapter 1: Autobots Turn: ==

==== Mission 1: Wrong Pace, Wrong Time ====
* Boss: Bonecrusher

==== Mission 2: Fight Fire With Fire ====
* Boss: Jetfire

==== Mission 3: Blast From The Past ====
* Boss: Bumblebee (DOTM)

==== Mission 4: Mixed Messages ====
* Boss: Blaster

==== Mission 5: Herald Of Destruction ====
* Boss: Shockwave

==== Mission 6: Dark Arrival ====
* Boss: Megatronus

== Chapter 2: Decepticons Burn ==

=== Mission 1: Fuel ===
* Boss: Cheetor

=== Mission 2: Fire ===
* Boss: Soundwave

=== Mission 3: Desire ===
* Boss: Megatron

=== Mission 4: Burn ===
* Boss: Thundercracker

=== Mission 5: Face ===
* Boss: Starscream

=== Mission 6: Upon The Chrome ===
* Boss: Megatronus

== Chapter 3: Hit The Road ==
=== Mission 1: Haste ===
* Boss: Hound

=== Mission 2: Heated ===
* Boss: Motormaster

=== Mission 3: Accelerated ===
* Boss: Sideswipe

=== Mission 4: Angered ===
* Boss: Hot Rod

=== Mission 5: Velocity ===
* Boss: Mirage

=== Mission 6: Vexed ===
* Boss: Nemesis Prime

== Chapter 4: And I Saw ==

=== Mission 1: Horn of Doom ===
* Boss: Rhinox

=== Mission 2: Crown of Conquest ===
* Boss: Kickback

=== Mission 3: Sword of War ===
* Boss: Tantrum

=== Mission 4: Scales of Famine ===
* Boss: Nemesis Prime

=== Mission 5: Vision of Death ===
* Boss: Bludgeon

=== Mission 6: Darkness of Eternity ===
* Boss: Necrotronus
